mapper.sql: id, guild_kind AS guildKind, guild_id AS guildId, channel_id AS channelId, source, original_id AS originalId, actor_type AS actorType, actor_member_id AS actorMemberId, action, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, reason, changes_json AS changesJson, changes_redacted AS changesRedacted, original_time AS originalTime, DATE_FORMAT(original_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS originalTimeText, prev_hash AS prevHash, row_hash AS rowHash
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_channel_audit_head(guild_kind, guild_id, head_id, head_hash) VALUES (#{guildKind}, #{guildId}, 0, #{genesis}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE guild_kind = guild_kind
mapper.select: SELECT head_id AS headId, head_hash AS headHash FROM im_channel_audit_head WHERE guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND guild_id = #{guildId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_channel_audit_head SET head_id = #{headId}, head_hash = #{headHash}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND guild_id = #{guildId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.channel_id AS channelId, o.action, o.from_status AS fromStatus, o.to_status AS toStatus, o.reason, o.operator_id AS operatorId, o.create_time AS originalTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS originalTimeText FROM im_channel_op_log o JOIN im_channel c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE c.guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND c.guild_id = #{guildId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_channel_audit_log a WHERE a.source = 'CHANNEL_OP' AND a.original_id = o.id) ORDER BY o.create_time, o.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: FROM im_moderation_action m LEFT JOIN im_channel d ON d.guild_kind = m.guild_kind AND d.guild_id = m.guild_id AND d.is_default = 1 AND d.del_flag = 0 WHERE m.guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND m.guild_id = #{guildId} AND (m.scope_type = 'CHANNEL' OR d.id IS NOT NULL)

m.id, IF(m.scope_type = 'CHANNEL', m.scope_id, d.id) AS channelId, m.target_member_id AS targetMemberId, m.action_type AS actionType, m.scope_type AS scopeType, m.scope_id AS scopeId, m.reason_code AS reasonCode, m.duration_sec AS durationSec, m.delete_message_sec AS deleteMessageSec, m.operator_id AS operatorId, m.revoked_by AS revokedBy
mapper.select:
SELECT , m.starts_at AS originalTime, DATE_FORMAT(m.starts_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS originalTimeText
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_channel_audit_log a WHERE a.source = 'MODERATION' AND a.original_id = m.id) ORDER BY m.starts_at, m.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , m.revoked_at AS originalTime, DATE_FORMAT(m.revoked_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS originalTimeText
AND m.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_channel_audit_log a WHERE a.source = 'MODERATION_REVOKE' AND a.original_id = m.id) ORDER BY m.revoked_at, m.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM im_channel_op_log o JOIN im_channel c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE c.guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND c.guild_id = #{guildId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_channel_audit_log a WHERE a.source = 'CHANNEL_OP' AND a.original_id = o.id)) + (SELECT COUNT(1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_channel_audit_log a WHERE a.source = 'MODERATION' AND a.original_id = m.id)) + (SELECT COUNT(1) AND m.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_channel_audit_log a WHERE a.source = 'MODERATION_REVOKE' AND a.original_id = m.id))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_channel_audit_log(guild_kind, guild_id, channel_id, source, original_id, actor_type, actor_member_id, action, target_type, target_id, reason, changes_json, changes_redacted, original_time, prev_hash, row_hash) VALUES (#{guildKind}, #{guildId}, #{channelId}, #{source}, #{originalId}, #{actorType}, #{actorMemberId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{changesJson}, #{changesRedacted}, #{originalTimeText}, #{prevHash}, #{rowHash})
